# Description:
This remodel completely refreshes the appearance of sweet berry bushes, regular bushes, and firefly bushes with redesigned models and improved visuals. Every bush has been given a more refined and natural look while staying true to Minecraft's vanilla style. Whether you're exploring forests, decorating your builds, or tending berry patches, these updated bushes blend seamlessly into the world and make vegetation feel more detailed without changing any gameplay mechanics. This is a purely visual remodel, so all bushes function exactly as they do in vanilla Minecraft.
